title: Love came toddling
author: Tapeshwar Prasad
text:
What I bored with me, calcified
deeper
into layers of my previous life -
A painter, a poet, and a rustic man
tilling and toiling my sweat out
was
but a flick of a luck
searching for a meaningful existence
Aka love
with a dab of a brush and splash of an ink pen.

Now that I sheared away all, that
was bedeviling me previously;
and
Love came toddling
shorter with steps.
